ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer (roycho96 fork)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team (forked by roycho96)
ModMetaData.description:
roycho96 public fork of RimWorld Multiplayer, based on upstream dev e760d30.
Retains the original team's work and license. Fork source: https://github.com/roycho96/Multiplayer
This build uses a separate network and replay protocol. All players must use the same fork build and mod versions. Use revision 1 of the roycho96 Multiplayer Compatibility fork when compatibility patches are needed. Older multiplayer replays require their original mod versions. Save to a single-player .rws file before moving an existing game to this build.
Place below Core, expansions, Harmony and Prepatcher. Enable only one mod with packageId rwmt.Multiplayer.
FAQ - https://hackmd.io/@rimworldmultiplayer/docs/ Original - https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer
